newsitem.title: EGYPT: Four bludgeoned to death in southern Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Four bludgeoned to death in southern Egypt.

text.p: A widow and three of her daughters, aged eight, nine and 22, were bludgeoned to death in their home in southern Egypt, security sources said on Sunday.
The four, each killed with a blow on the head with a sharp instrument, were found on Saturday in the village of Naga Khidr, about 280 km (170 miles) south of Cairo, they said.
Police have detained for questioning a fourth daughter, aged 19, who told them she had spent the night of Friday and Saturday at the house of her married half-sister, they added.
